name: Amamiya Akira
source:
She is the homeroom teacher in charge of the class.

She is a beautiful and caring teacher who is well-liked by her students. She is an intelligent and mature woman who is able to create a friendly atmosphere from the students' point of view.

In her private life, she easily manipulates men in the palm of her hands. As a matter of fact, her fiancee is currently making preparations for their wedding.

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/saimin/index.html]official site[/url]]
